articles.summary: Investment in SBA loan fund expands access to capital for local businesses and job creation EVERETT, Wash., Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Coastal Community Bank (the “Bank”, “Coastal”, “us”, “our”, “we”) announced a $5 million investment in the Solomon Hess SBA Loan Fund, reinforcing the Bank's commitment to supporting small businesses, economic development, and job creation throughout Snohomish and King Counties. The investment advances Coastal's Federal Reserve-approved Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) Strategic Plan and expands access to capital for businesses that may not qualify for traditional financing. The investment supports the SBA 7(a) loan program, which helps small businesses secure financing needed to grow, create jobs, and contribute to local economic development. articles.title: Coastal Community Bank Commits $5 Million to Support Small Business Growth and Economic Opportunity

articles.summary: EVERETT, Wash., Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Coastal Community Bank (the “Bank”, “Coastal”, or “we”) has awarded three multiyear community development grants totaling $375,000 to nonprofit organizations serving Snohomish and King counties. Local Initiatives Support Corporation Puget Sound (“LISC”) received a $150,000 grant over three years to support community development efforts in Everett and Snohomish County. The funding will help bring community partners together, strengthen local organizations, coordinate development strategies, and advance projects that expand housing and economic opportunity. LISC provides community development services by coordinating cross-sector partnerships, convening public agencies and nonprofit organizations, and delivering technical assistance and capacity-building support to housing developers and community-based organizations serving low- and moderate-income communities. articles.summary: Investment supports attainable housing for working individuals and families and helps leverage innovative public-private-philanthropic housing programs. EVERETT, Wash., Oct. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Coastal Community Bank (the “Bank”, “Coastal”, “our”) announced its participation in Koz Development's PNW Attainable Workforce Housing Fund, a community development investment focused on expanding high-quality, environmentally responsible housing for working individuals and families across the Pacific Northwest. Koz Development's PNW Attainable Workforce Housing Fund (“Fund”) was established to provide equity financing for attainable and workforce housing in growing communities throughout Washington and Oregon. The Fund focuses on well-located housing near employment centers, educational institutions, transportation, and essential services — places where working households can remain connected to the communities in which they live and work.
